title: How an Electric Scooter Works in 60 Seconds 🛴⚡ #shorts
description:
An electric scooter stores energy in a lithium-ion battery pack in its deck. A controller sends pulses of current to a brushless hub motor hidden inside the wheel, and when you brake, regenerative braking turns the motor into a generator to send some energy back. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#electricscooter #escooter #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: On most electric scooters, the motor is hidden *inside the wheel*.

steps.label: Battery
steps.text: A *lithium-ion pack* in the deck, often *36 volts*, stores the energy.

steps.label: Controller
steps.text: Press the throttle and a *controller* sends rapid pulses of *current* to the motor.

steps.label: Hub motor
steps.text: Inside the hub, *electromagnets* switch on in turn, pulling a ring of *magnets* around.

steps.label: Sensors
steps.text: Tiny *Hall sensors* track the magnets, so the controller knows exactly which coils to fire *next*.

steps.label: Regen
steps.text: When you brake, the motor works as a *generator*, sending some energy *back to the battery*.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Store, pulse, *spin*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
